notes.title: The brand-new FREE DLC of Castle Morihisa is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

The brand-new FREE DLC of Castle Morihisa is now available on Steam! Download now and you will be able to play as Miko, the devout maiden using the energy of the moon!

The symbol of holiness blessed by the moon—the devout girl finally decides to pick up her bow and arrows and venture into Morihisa Castle alone. Will the holy maiden unveil the secrets of Morihisa Castle? 

The new DLC contains 67 unique class cards and 28 powerful class talents. With the help of the moon, Miko can unleash her true power in both the full moon and dark moon phases, bringing new battle styles and strategies to the game!

Miko uses the energy of the moon and has an exclusive "Lunar Phase" system. When it's "Full Moon" or "Dark Moon", the special effect of her deck will be activated. Use the "Lunar Phase" system well to exterminate all the enemies standing in your way and embrace your destiny!

Thank you all so much for your huge support! We'll keep polishing the game to present the best possible game experience. Please stay tuned!

Join our Discord to hang out: [url=https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a]https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a[/url]

notes.title: FREE DLC Available Soon & Patch Notes Update!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! A major DLC of Castle Morihisa will be available for free soon!

In this new patch, you'll be able to play Miko, a brand-new class with unique battle style and various stategy combinations inspired by the ever-changing lunar phase. 

And you could take a peek at Miko's preview in the game now! Please stay tuned!

In the meantime, please check out these following adjustments we made to balance the game. 

1. "Healthy"has been replaced by "Potential" in Common Talent.
Potential:When you exhaust your action points for the first time on your turn, reduce the action point cost of 1 random card(s) in your hand to 0 for this turn.
2. "Perfect Deliberation"'s efffect has been replaced by "For each Tactic card you play, draw 1 Tactic card(s) and reduce the action point cost by 1 for this turn." in Common Talent.
3. Golem's buff "Bulwark"'s effect has been changed from "Is immune to all attacks that deal less than 6 damage." to "Is immune to all attacks that deal less than 4 damage."
4.Terror Arachnid's health has been changed from "76" to "50".
5. Black Treant's health has been changed from "72" to "60".
6. Ghost Lantern's health has been changed from "68" to "54".
7. Demon Soldier's health has been changed from "88" to "65".
8. Giant Toad's health has been changed from "48" to "40".
9. Archer's health has been changed from "30" to "25".
10. Ghost Lantern's base damage has been changed from "10" to "6".
11. Carrion Raven's buff "Dive"'s damage has been changed from "12" to "9".
12. Spearman's armor has been changed from "5" to "4".
13. Lethal Snakes' buff "Poison Fang"'s damage has been changed from "5" to "4",and its "Attack"'s times has been changed from "3" to "2".
14. Fleshworm Spawn's health has been changed from "25" to "20".
15. Fleshworm Egg's health has been changed from "38" to "30".
16. When Fleshworm dies, only one Fleshworm Spawn will be summoned.
17. Difficulty VI's effect has been changed from "Enemies have 2 more strength." to "Enemies have 1 more strength."
18. Hattori Hanzo's effect has been changed by "If an enemy has 20 health or less, ignore their armor and deal 20 damage."
19. Fixed several game bugs.

Thank you all so much for your support! Join our Discord to send us feedback and have a chat!
[url=https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a]https://discord.gg/2FZVprUb2a[/url]

notes.title: 《森久城物语》1.0.79版本更新公告
notes.notes:
Hi warriors! Thanks for playing Castle Morihisa! Please check out some more adjustments we made to balance the game. If you didn’t get the notifications for the update, please restart the Steam client.

Major Adjustment
1. Requirements to unlock new classes have been changed. All of the first 3 classes are now available by default. The class Ninja will be unlocked as long as you have won at least 1 round with any of the first 3 classes.

Enemy Adjustments
1. Ghost Lantern: Increased basic damage of “Scorch” from 2 to 3. Reduced damage times from 5 to 3.
2. Kasa-Obake: Decreased basic damage of “Swirl” from 3 to 1.
3. Carrion Raven: Decreased basic damage from 8 to 6.
4. Fleshworm Egg: Decreased health from 25 to 20. Decreased gained armor from “Resilience” from 8 to 4.
5. Killer Eel: Fixed the bug of “Corrosive Acid”. Changed the effect from “Armor gained from defense cards reduced by 50%” to “Armor gained from all cards reduced by 50%”.

Card Adjustments
1. Onmyoji attack card “Soul Siphon”: Increased its rarity from 2 stars to 3 stars.
2. Onmyoji attack card “Expunge Ghost”: Decreased its rarity from 3 stars to 2 stars.
3. Onmyoji card “Wolf Greed”: Changed the card effect to “The first time you leech in each turn, gain 1 action point.”
4. Onmyoji card “Spirit Rush”: Fixed the bug that action points will be recovered even when there’s currently no shikigami. 
5. Samurai card “Sturdy+”: Increased cost from 1 to 2.

Talent Adjustments
1. General talent “Regulate Breathing”: Increased health recovered from 2 to 3.
2. Samurai talent “Red Sakura”: Changed the effect from “If you lose 15 or more health to an attack, gain 1 Blossom card” to “If you lose 8 or more health to an attack, gain 1 Blossom card”.
3. Monk talent “Impel”: Increased the card draw from 2 to 3.

Other Adjustments
1. Optimized the location of enemies’ name display.
2. Optimized the buff and tip display when using controllers.
3. Fixed some text errors.
4. Fixed several bugs that might cause game crashes

notes.title: Castle Morihisa 1.0.77 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Castle Morihisa! 
We have read through all of your feedback and suggestions and these are really important to us. However, it will take us some time to come up with better plans to balance the game and do rounds of testing. For the time being, we will fix bugs that affect gameplay and get to the game balance soon. Thanks for your understanding and support!

New Updates
1. Fixed the bug of events where one cannot choose to donate certain coins or sacrifice HP in exchange of rewards.
2. Fixed the bug that one cannot check the upgraded version of the card [Divination+].
3. Added more tips of enemies’ current status.
More descriptions of effects will now appear in the monsters’ intentions for better understanding.
4. Optimized texts.

notes.title: Castle Morihisa Demo Removal Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear warriors,

Thank you all for your support for Castle Morihisa!

We have received lots of feedback and suggestions since our demo build has been published. You have helped us create a better game! Thanks! And we will be keep working on the game to improve it. The current demo will no longer represent our game quality.

After a thorough discussion, we decided to remove the demo of Castle Morihisa from Steam at 12:30 p.m., Feb 10th  (GMT). Players will not be able to download, install or start the demo afterwards.

Thank you again for your great support! And if you like our game, a positive review will be much appreciated. Many thanks!

notes.title: Castle Morihisa Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow samurais and ninjas!

Welcome to Castle Morihisa, a world full of bizarre mysteries and curious challenges! To celebrate the launch, we have put the game on sale for 10% off for a whole week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608040/_/

Castle Morihisa is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy feudal Japan. Here you will be able to play 4 different classes, build up your own deck with almost 300 unique cards, take advantage of dozens of fallen heroes and treasure that could bring you an edge during combats, and encounter and vanquish hundreds of monsters from Japanese folklore. Other than that, our special talent system will help you set up your deck fast. It’s time to test your strategies!

Come join our community to exchange ideas of your deck and combat styles with others!

Discord: https://discord.gg/MWbwZSY
Twitter: @ThermiteGamesHQ
